participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You stopped where the vale opened, and you went on.

title: Stopped on Sun Rising Hill and looked at the Vale

participation.context: Sat, shaved, and stayed until you were ready to go on.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You spoke from the water, with the heel already bound. You did not rebind it there.

title: Sat in the brook and shaved by feel

story.body: You looked at the arches in the river, and then you left the bridge.

title: Looked at the fourteen arches in the river

participation.context: Answered the miles, and gave the pack over.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Took a hundred, and did not take the pack.

participation.context: Looked at your feet and said nothing.

story.body: You let Judith have the walk and Hamnet have the hundred. Susanna did not speak. Richard took the pack, and you settled the flat parcel on top.

title: Came over the bridge and let Richard take the pack

participation.context: Answered her, and sat in the tub.

participation.context: Sat you down and dressed the blisters.

story.body: You gave her the horse as the reason. You did not give her another. You sat, and she dressed the two burst blisters.
